scope: independent root audit of the nondegenerate affine coordinates, selected-prime algebraic integer, Galois cutoff action, norm implication and height, ray capacity, replay, and chart warning

checks.root_repairs: Repinned the checker and manifest to audited canonical predecessors, including the regenerated Item 397 checker and Item 349 report, and regenerated all certificate outputs. No mathematical statement changed.

mathematical_audit.affine_pair: On the nondegenerate chart all displayed multipliers are p-units and the Item 341 Jacobian is a unit. The two actual collision coordinates are therefore exactly the scalar endpoint numerator E and the incomplete-beta residual H_m-Theta.
mathematical_audit.chosen_prime: Jacobi sums and character values are algebraic integers. Multiplication by the rational-target denominator Q and subtraction of A produces Xi in the cyclotomic integer ring, whose reduction at the specified Teichmuller prime is Q(H_m-Theta).
mathematical_audit.galois_action: Every cyclotomic automorphism sends B_u to B_(au) and fixes the quadratic character because a is odd. It therefore replaces the ordered prefix by a multiplicatively permuted subset rather than preserving the selected cutoff.
mathematical_audit.norm: The selected-prime divisibility implies p divides the rational norm. Since p splits completely, the converse is only existence of a divisibility at some conjugate prime/cutoff, so the ordinary norm forgets the selector without an additional equivalence theorem.
mathematical_audit.height: Each nonexceptional Jacobi sum has complex absolute value sqrt(p); combining m=O(M), target height O(M log M), and cyclotomic degree O(M) gives the stated O(M^2 log M) norm-height ceiling per row.
mathematical_audit.capacity: Each residue ray has Chebyshev mass M/35+o(M), but a theorem on only the nondegenerate or degenerate chart cannot book a fixed saving while the complementary chart may fill the ray. No positive ray exclusion is proved.
